sections.heading: About Scenario Studio
sections.intro: Scenario Studio adalah visual editor drag-and-drop untuk merancang aturan deteksi fraud tanpa kode. Ada 2 tipe rule (GENERAL 3 langkah, CONDITION 4 langkah) dan 6 tipe kondisi.

steps.title: What is Scenario Studio
steps.desc:
{previewHtml:1}
• Editor drag-and-drop visual berbasis ReactFlow
• 2 tipe rule: GENERAL (3 langkah) dan CONDITION (4 langkah)
• 6 tipe kondisi: LOGICAL, CONTAINS, CONSTANT, DEVIATION, AGGREGATE, GEO
• Siklus hidup rule: Draft → Submit → Approve → Activate
